pageTitle: The Stilled Interstice of a Thousand Winds
name: The Stilled Interstice of a Thousand Winds
description: The gentle sea breeze carries the scent of fine wine through the bustling port. Yet there are places that even the ever-present wind cannot reach, or rather, it chooses not to. Should one choose to follow a secluded path to the tranquil mountain sanatorium, what might await — peaceful rest, or an adventure beyond mortal imagination?
